content.title: Trader Joe’s recall expands, millions of pounds of frozen meals may contain glass
content.text: More frozen food products sold at Trader Joe’s are being recalled in 43 states — including Rhode Island and Massachusetts — because they may contain “foreign objects” including glass, according to a recent notice from the US Food and Drug Administration.Foods sold at Rhode Island Trader Joe’s stores in Providence and Warwick are included in the recall.The recalled foods could contain pieces of glass from 1 to 3 centimeters long, according to the FDA.
